privacy.s1Content: We collect information to provide, maintain, and improve our services. The types of information we collect include:
privacy.s1List: Account Information: When you register, we collect your name, email address, and optionally a profile photo. If you sign up using Google OAuth, we collect the information your Google account makes available to us (name, email, and profile picture). | Profile Information: Bio, skills, avatar, banner, and any other content you add to your public profile. | User Content: Projects, blog posts, forum threads, comments, messages, and any other content you create or upload to the Platform. | Usage Data: Information about how you interact with the Platform, including pages visited, time spent on pages, features used, and interactions with other users. | Technical Data: IP address, browser type and version, device type, operating system, referring URLs, and unique device identifiers.
privacy.s2Content: We use the collected information for the following purposes:
privacy.s2List: To provide, operate, maintain, and improve the Platform and its features | To authenticate your identity, secure your account, and prevent unauthorized access | To display your profile and content to other users in accordance with your preferences | To communicate with you, including sending account-related notifications, updates, and support responses | To respond to your comments, questions, and requests for support | To detect, prevent, and address fraudulent, abusive, or illegal activity | To analyze usage patterns and trends to improve user experience and develop new features | To enforce our Terms of Service and other policies | To comply with legal obligations and regulatory requirements
privacy.s3Content: We respect your privacy and do not sell your personal information to third parties. We may share your information only in the following circumstances:
privacy.s3List: With your explicit consent: We will share your information when you have given us clear permission to do so. | With service providers: We engage trusted third-party service providers to help us operate the Platform, including hosting providers (Neon, Vercel), analytics services, and email delivery services. These providers are contractually bound to protect your information. | For legal reasons: We may disclose your information if required to do so by law, or in response to valid legal requests by public authorities (e.g., court orders, subpoenas). | To protect rights and safety: We may disclose information when we believe it is necessary to investigate, prevent, or take action regarding illegal activities, suspected fraud, potential threats to the safety of any person, or violations of our Terms of Service. | Business transfers: In the event of a merger, acquisition, reorganization, or sale of assets, your information may be transferred as part of that transaction. We will notify you of any such change.
privacy.s4Content: We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal information. Your data is stored securely on servers provided by Neon (PostgreSQL) for database storage and Vercel for application hosting. We use encryption in transit (TLS/SSL) and at rest to protect your data. However, no method of transmission over the Internet or electronic storage is 100% secure. While we strive to use commercially acceptable means to protect your personal information, we cannot guarantee its absolute security.
privacy.s5Content: We retain your personal information for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide you with the Platform's services. If you delete your account, we will delete or anonymize your personal information within 30 days, except where retention is required by law (e.g., for tax, legal reporting, or dispute resolution purposes). We may retain anonymized, aggregated data indefinitely for analytics and improvement purposes.
privacy.s6Content: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the following rights regarding your personal information:
privacy.s6List: Right to Access: You can request a copy of the personal data we hold about you. | Right to Rectification: You can request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data. | Right to Deletion: You can request deletion of your personal data (subject to legal exceptions). | Right to Restrict Processing: You can request that we limit how we use your data. | Right to Data Portability: You can request a copy of your data in a structured, machine-readable format. | Right to Object: You can object to our processing of your data for certain purposes. | Right to Withdraw Consent: Where processing is based on consent, you may withdraw it at any time without affecting the lawfulness of processing based on consent before its withdrawal.
privacy.s6Footer: To exercise any of these rights, please contact us using the email address provided below. We will respond to your request within 30 days.
privacy.s7Content: We use essential cookies and similar technologies for authentication, session management, and security purposes. These cookies are necessary for the Platform to function properly. We may also use analytics cookies (e.g., Vercel Analytics) to understand how visitors interact with the Platform and to improve user experience. You can control cookie settings through your browser preferences. Please note that disabling certain cookies may affect the functionality of the Platform.
privacy.s8Content: The Platform relies on the following third-party services to operate. Each service has its own privacy policy governing how they handle your data:
privacy.s8List: Google OAuth: Used for authentication via Google accounts. Google's privacy policy applies to data shared through Google sign-in. | Neon (PostgreSQL): Used for database hosting and storage. Data is stored on Neon's servers with encryption at rest and in transit. | Vercel: Used for application hosting, deployment, and analytics. Vercel may collect usage data as described in their privacy policy.
privacy.s8Footer: We encourage you to review the privacy policies of these third-party providers for more information on their data handling practices.
privacy.s9Content: Last Peace of Art is not directed at children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If we become aware that a child under 13 has provided us with personal information, we will take steps to delete such information as soon as possible. If you believe that a child under 13 has provided us with personal information, please contact us immediately.
privacy.s10Content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices, legal requirements, or operational needs. When we make material changes, we will notify you by email (if you have provided one) or by posting a prominent notice on the Platform. We encourage you to review this Privacy Policy periodically. Your continued use of the Platform after any changes constitutes your acceptance of the updated policy.
privacy.s11Content: If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us at:

about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Your space to create, share, and connect
about.ownerDesc: The creator and owner of Last Peace of Art. A passionate developer and community builder who believes in the power of creation and connection.
about.whatIs: What is Last Peace of Art?
about.whatIsDesc: Last Peace of Art is a creative platform where you can showcase your projects, write blog posts, share your profile, and engage in community discussions. It's a space designed for creators, developers, and artists to express themselves and connect with like-minded people.
about.featureProjects: Showcase your work — Upload and present your projects to the community with rich media galleries, tags, and markdown content.
about.featurePosts: Write about your passions — Share tutorials, thoughts, and stories through our blogging platform.
about.featureForum: Start discussions — Engage with the community, ask questions, and share knowledge in our forum.
about.featureProfile: Build your profile — Create a stunning public profile to display your skills, experience, and personality.
about.featureMessages: Connect with others — Send messages and make friends with other members of the community.
about.howToDesc: Simply create a free account, set up your profile, and start exploring. You can post projects, write articles, join discussions, and connect with other creators right away.
about.missionDesc: To provide a welcoming and inspiring space where creativity meets community. We believe everyone has something valuable to share, and we're here to help you share it with the world.
about.footer: Last Peace of Art — Created with passion.

roles.title: Roles & Ranks
roles.metaDesc: Learn about site roles, how to earn them, and their perks.
roles.subtitle: Every member has one or more roles that determine their permissions and perks on the site. Here's what each role means:
roles.cta: Want to see what badges you can earn?

user.name: 👤 User
user.desc: Standard member with full access to all basic features.
user.perk: Create posts, threads, projects, and comments.

bug_hunter.name: 🐛 Bug Hunter
bug_hunter.desc: Helped improve the site by reporting bugs.
bug_hunter.req: Submit 3 confirmed bug reports via the ticket system.
bug_hunter.perk: Bug Hunter role on your profile + access to private beta features.

premium.name: 💎 Premium
premium.perk: Custom profile theme, priority support, and ad-free browsing.

moderator.name: 🛡️ Moderator
moderator.desc: Trusted community member who helps keep the site clean.
moderator.req: Appointed by the admin/founder based on trust and activity.
moderator.perk: Ability to moderate content (edit, delete, toggle publish).

admin.name: ⚡ Admin
admin.desc: Site administrator with full management access.
admin.perk: Full access to admin panel, user management, and settings.

founder.name: 👑 Founder
founder.desc: Site creator and owner — this role cannot be obtained by anyone else.
founder.req: Only the site founder has this role. It cannot be earned or assigned.
founder.perk: Full control over every aspect of the site + ability to assign roles and badges to users.
